title: 1812 belts sit tight, silver is engraved, and backlit lips calm down
items: Potawatomi men's belts now sit on the shirt or blanket instead of floating round the waist, and the shirt below the waist no longer starts wider than the shirt above it. Belt, shirt and blanket now move together when a man walks or turns.
Silver arm bands and brooches are engraved, with border lines, a zigzag and punched dots. You only see it up close, and it uses no extra memory.
Lips in every year are closer to the person's own skin tone, and where the lips meet is shaded. A face lit from behind no longer shows a pink line across the mouth.
